Luis Pina Lopes – Studio is an architecture and design service that is quite different from what we usually know. Luis Pina Lopes – Studio go beyond geometry, terrain, materials, and objects. The development of each project focuses on 5 key values: Creativity, unity, vision, proximity and connection. The architecture and design carried out by my focus on the Being (Human), on its tangible as well as non-visible needs, my architecture and design focus on the soul of those who inhabit or use my spaces, and objects.
